title: Phase 2 game-development knowledge (adapted to Pixel Studio baselines)

references.title: Unreal 5.4 C++ and Blueprints: reflection, GC safety and the C++/Blueprint split
references.changes: Re-targeted from UE 5.8 to 5.4, removing the C++20 floor, UE_LOGF, the 5.9 Blueprint scripting APIs, editor MCP and toolchain tables; added BlueprintImplementableEvent/NativeEvent guidance; moved build and test commands to a human-only section.

references.title: Unreal 5.4 Enhanced Input: actions, mapping contexts, triggers and buffering
references.changes: Re-targeted from UE 5.8 to 5.4, marking 5.8-only changes (Input Debugger, Combo deprecation, touch fix) as not on 5.4, adding an input-buffering pattern and verify lines for the User Settings rebinding APIs, and removing shell/test commands.

references.title: Unreal 5.4 Behavior Trees, Blackboards, EQS and AI Perception
references.changes: Re-targeted from UE 5.8 to 5.4, removing the 5.8/5.9 StateTree and EQS features, reducing StateTree to a verify-on-5.4 note, adding an AI Perception section and removing find/grep and headless test commands.

references.title: Unity C# core for Unity 6 (6000.0) and 2022.3 LTS: lifecycle, serialization, ScriptableObjects, asmdefs and tests
references.changes: Re-targeted from Unity 6.3 to Unity 6 (6000.0) and 2022.3 with a table giving both API forms (Find*, velocity, PhysicsMaterial, Awaitable, project-wide actions), removing the Python checker, Unity CLI and shell steps and keeping batch-mode commands human-only.

references.title: Unity Input System and physics for Unity 6 (6000.0) and 2022.3 LTS
references.changes: Re-targeted from Unity 6.3 and Input System 1.20 to 6000.0 and 2022.3, adding package-version verify lines, a 2022.3-vs-Unity-6 physics API table and Unity-6-only marks (project-wide actions, linearVelocityX, Slide), and removing CLI, low-level 2D physics and shell content.

references.title: Phaser 3.90 core: game config, scene lifecycle, loader and scene flow
references.changes: Re-targeted from Phaser 4.2 to 3.90 only, moving v4 filter/lighting/tint/TAU changes into a do-not-use section, marking the 4.2.1 keyboard diagnosis as verify-on-3.90 and replacing the package-manager/browser-automation smoke test with browser-console checks for the human.

references.title: Phaser 3.90 Arcade Physics: bodies, colliders, pools, categories and tilemaps
references.changes: Re-targeted from Phaser 4.2.1 to 3.90, marking defaults checked only in v4 source as verify-on-3.90, adding tilemap collision and fixed-step/tunnelling sections and removing build and browser-automation commands.

references.title: Game AI: Decision Models, Behavior Trees and Utility AI
references.changes: Merged two AI skills and the AI code rules into one engine-neutral reference, with C# snippets only and notes for UE 5.4, Unity 6 / 2022.3 and Phaser 3.90.

references.title: Procedural Generation: Seeds, Layouts and Validation
references.changes: Translated Python snippets to C# and prose, added level-design soft-lock gating ideas and seed-sweep acceptance criteria, and re-targeted the engine RNG notes.

references.title: Save Systems: Schemas, Migration and Crash-Safe Writes
references.changes: Moved storage notes from Unity 6.3 / UE 5.8 to Unity 6 / 2022.3 and UE 5.4, added Phaser web storage and run-versus-profile state, and removed headless and console commands.

references.title: Game Feel: Hit-Stop, Shake, Squash and Responsiveness
references.changes: Replaced Godot code with C#, added the tier table, latency/buffer/coyote guidance from the GDD feel template and accessibility toggles, and added notes for UE 5.4, Unity and Phaser.

references.title: Input Systems: Actions, Buffering, Rebinding and Devices
references.changes: Replaced Godot InputMap code with C# and prose, turned the binding audit script into a checklist, and added notes for UE Enhanced Input, the Unity Input System and Phaser input.

references.title: Camera Systems: Follow, Dead Zones, Look-Ahead and Pixel-Perfect 2D
references.changes: Replaced Godot code with C#, re-targeted Cinemachine notes to Unity 6 / 2022.3, added a labelled pixel-perfect section, and added UE 5.4 spring-arm and Phaser camera notes.

references.title: Physics Tuning: Timestep, Scale, Jump Arcs and Tunnelling
references.changes: Removed Godot test scripts and commands, translated the accumulator loop to TypeScript, added units/scale, jump-arc formulas and determinism caveats, and added notes for UE 5.4, Unity and Phaser Arcade.

references.title: Game UI/UX: HUDs, Menus, Scaling, Focus and Accessibility
references.changes: Removed Godot code and resolution-sweep commands, merged the UX checklist and UI code rules into an accessibility table, and added notes for UE UMG, Unity UGUI/UI Toolkit and Phaser.

references.title: Performance Optimization: Measure First, Then Fix One Bottleneck
references.changes: Moved profiler notes from UE 5.8 / Unity 6.3 to UE 5.4 / Unity 6 / 2022.3, added browser DevTools for Phaser and the NOT ASSESSED reporting rule, and put UE console commands in a human-only section.

supplements.title: Engine-specific verification for implement-gameplay-system (Unreal 5.4, Unity 6 / 2022.3, Phaser 3.90)
supplements.changes: Turned the upstream Verify sections into engine-specific static pre-hand-off checks (headers/modules, serialization/meta/asmdefs, scene lifecycle) for agents that cannot compile, plus a mandatory honest compile/run status line; no shell steps.

supplements.title: Supplement: Optimize a game for mobile (measure-first method)
supplements.changes: Adds input FOUND/ABSENT checks, uncapped release-build measurement, CPU/GPU side selection, budget proposals for the Producer, and NOT ASSESSED failure handling to the base skill.

supplements.title: Supplement: Design a level (procedurally generated levels)
supplements.changes: Adds a gating-graph table, key-order and drop-landing soft-lock checks, pacing rules as data, and seed-sweep acceptance criteria for generated levels.

supplements.title: Supplement: Create a test plan (story types and verification checks)
supplements.changes: Adds Logic/Integration/Visual-Feel/UI/Config story classification with default evidence, smoke scope, discipline verification cases and an empty-scope NOT ASSESSED rule, keeping the base skill's honest not-executed statuses.
